BiblicalUsage: Kelimmuth means disgrace, reproach. Jeremiah 23:40 says God will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe shame that God lays on is not forgotten, because the prophets he mocked were his own messengers.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
